title: Bring your favorite recipes together
body:
Create a database for dishes you love and recipes you want to try.

Make your own digital cookbook

Image ( https://notion.so/build-database?utm_campaign=%5Bgtm+2.0%5D+scheduled_run+campaign&utm_campaignid=1024&utm_campaigntype=transactional&utm_content=Email&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io )

Create a recipe database and add one row for every dish you cook, save, or want to try. It’s a simple way to bring scattered links, family recipes, and meal ideas together.

Start with a few favorites. Over time, you’ll build a personal cookbook that’s easier to return to than a folder full of bookmarks.
